title: What is Python?
overview: Python is a high-level, interpreted programming language known for its simple syntax and readability. It is widely used for web development, automation, data science, artificial intelligence, and scripting.

title: Why Do We Use Python?
overview: Python is popular because it is easy to learn, has a large community, and provides many libraries for different types of development.

example.title: Python Uses
example.content:
✔ Web Development
✔ Data Science
✔ Artificial Intelligence
✔ Automation
✔ Backend Development

title: Features of Python
overview: Python provides features like simple syntax, interpreted execution, dynamic typing, object-oriented programming support, and a large collection of libraries.

example.title: Python Features
example.content:
✔ Easy Syntax
✔ Cross Platform
✔ Open Source
✔ Large Library Support
✔ Object Oriented

title: Python vs Other Languages
overview: Python focuses on simplicity and productivity compared to languages like Java and C++. Its syntax requires fewer lines of code for many tasks.

title: Where Python is Used
overview: Python is used in many industries including software development, machine learning, automation, cybersecurity, and backend systems.

example.title: Real World Usage
example.content:
• Instagram Backend
• Machine Learning Models
• Automation Scripts
• Data Analysis

overview: You learned what Python is, why it is popular, its features, comparisons with other languages, and real-world applications.
